notes.epoch_context: Epoch 1793836800 opened 2026-11-05T00:00:00Z (boundary block 53523727, ts 1793836801). Votes were cast during epoch 1793232000. All three boundary phases landed on-chain: run 207 (phase 1, k=8, block 53523623, T-207s), run 208 (phase 2, k=8, block 53523709, T-35s), run 209 (phase 3, k=6, block 53523720, T-13s, send-time expected $1,262.72), which is the binding allocation; lastVoted 1793836787 equals its block time. The monitor logged phase 2 as FAILED ('timed out after 20s'), but the vote had been sent at T-37s and the receipt shows status 1 with 48 logs; the time limit expired around the time it landed. The backup vote, run 206 (2026-11-04T16:54Z, k=12, expected $4,629.64), was replaced; as last week, its expectation came from real USDC bribes other voters had not yet piled into.

Against run 209's realized-at-boundary entitlement of $1,272.83 it is +$0.28; all 12 tokens reconcile on amount (ratios 0.9998-1.0002 from UI rounding), and the USD difference is price movement since the boundary snapshot.

notes.price_feed: The routing-divergence audit found no unhandled persistent overprice. The 2026-11-04 backup vote kept five clamped prices (CREATOR, wtIAU, wtTSLA, yUTY, mUSDC), together worth under $10 across all pools; wtTSLA's $341.69 clamp had no DexScreener corroboration and about $0.08 of it was in a pool the backup voted for.
notes.claim_swap_outcome: Claimed and swapped 2026-11-05. 30 of 30 escrow claim batches successful (--claim-source escrow, 15 gauges: the union of the backup vote and all three phases), no rate-limit retries. The wallet started at zero for all 12 reward tokens and ended at a 0.9998-1.0002 ratio to the table: gross received $1,273.11. The router-batch swap delivered 13.41188 USDC for 3 legs (GOO 5.73682, WETH 4.790479, EURC 2.884581) marked at $13.44 (-0.21%). Tokens below the $1 dust threshold or on the skip list were left unswapped, of which this epoch's are wtSPCX, SPCXc, wtTSLA, TSLAc, wtMSFT, MSFTc, SKHYc and wtSKHY (about $0.65). End state 1,272.634845 USDC = 1,259.222965 claimed + 13.41188 swapped. Gas 0.000108 ETH: 0.000094 claims, 0.000014 approvals and executeSwaps.
